description: Track B — Navigation: collapsible sidebar (icons-only when collapsed, persisted, accessible) + Resident menu group with 'Edit profile' and 'Issue new parking pass' child links. Requirements AC-2.1..2.6; design section 2. Depends on nothing; its menu.ts changes feed FEAT-005's menu pruning, so land B before E.
steps: In apps/web/src/menu.ts: give each top-level MenuGroup/MenuItem an optional `icon` (inline-SVG component or id; a default covers anything unset). Change the Resident group from `items: []` to two child items: { id:'profile', labelKey:'nav.editProfile', to:`${base}/r?edit=1` } and { id:'newpass', labelKey:'nav.newPass', to:`${base}/r#new` }, so it renders as an expandable group like the others.

In apps/web/src/components/Shell.tsx (AppShell): own a `collapsed` boolean, lazy-init from localStorage key 'op.menu.collapsed' wrapped in try/catch (fall back to expanded, mirroring readOpen in AppMenu.tsx). Reflect it as data-collapsed on the .shell element. Pass collapsed + a setter to AppMenu. Add a toggle <button> (in the sidebar footer, optionally mirrored in the topbar) with aria-expanded, aria-controls='app-menu', and a localized aria-label (t('nav.collapse')/t('nav.expand')). Persist on toggle via localStorage in try/catch.

In apps/web/src/components/AppMenu.tsx: when collapsed, visually hide (not DOM-remove) the brand text, org name, property/site/locale selects, group labels and sub-item text; render an icon per top-level destination with a title tooltip and the text as aria-label. Clicking a collapsed group icon expands the whole sidebar and opens that group (no hover-only flyout). Keep keyboard operability and aria-expanded on the toggle.

In apps/web/src/styles.css: add the collapsed grid-column width (e.g. 252px -> 64px) and hidden-label rules near the existing .shell/.side block using LOGICAL properties only (inline-size, inset-inline-start, padding-inline, margin-inline); animate grid-template-columns / inline-size. On the mobile breakpoint the drawer governs and collapse is ignored (do not regress the phone drawer).

Add i18n keys nav.collapse, nav.expand, nav.editProfile, nav.newPass to ALL seven catalogs apps/web/src/locales/{en,es-MX,es-ES,pt-BR,fr,de,ar}.json (not en-XA.json) with matching placeholders (these are plain strings).

Update apps/web/test/menu.test.ts: the Resident group now carries the two child items for a resident (adjust the resident-group expectations — e.g. it('residents see only the resident view') still holds for group ids, but the resident group's items are now ['profile','newpass']); do not weaken coverage. Add/extend a rendered test that asserts the collapse toggle flips data-collapsed, persists to localStorage, and that collapsed icons expose accessible names (aria-label/title).
acceptance_criteria: The sidebar collapses on wide screens via a persistent, keyboard-operable toggle with aria-expanded; collapsed shows icons only, each with a visible tooltip and accessible name.
The collapsed/expanded preference persists across reloads via localStorage 'op.menu.collapsed' and survives private-mode errors (try/catch).
The Resident menu entry is a group with child links 'Edit profile' (-> /r?edit=1) and 'Issue new parking pass' (-> /r#new).
All new CSS is logical-only (check:css passes) and the phone drawer behavior is not regressed.
menu.test.ts and the collapse render test pass; i18n parity test passes with the four new keys in every catalog.
findings: DONE. menu.ts: MenuGroup/MenuItem gained optional `icon` (new MenuIcon type: resident|platform|operator|admin|profile|newpass; a default glyph covers anything unset). Resident group now carries child items profile (nav.editProfile -> `${base}/r?edit=1`) and newpass (nav.newPass -> `${base}/r#new`), so FEAT-005's menu pruning must preserve those two items. Shell.tsx (AppShell): owns `collapsed` boolean, lazy-init from localStorage key 'op.menu.collapsed' (value '1'/'0', try/catch, falls back to expanded), reflected as data-collapsed on .shell, passed to AppMenu with onToggleCollapsed; persisted on toggle. AppMenu.tsx: new props { collapsed, onToggleCollapsed }; added MenuIconGlyph (inline SVG per MenuIcon). Every top-level destination/group-head renders an icon + a .menu-label span; brand/org/property/site/locale selects/signout all got className 'menu-label'. When collapsed, .menu-label is visually hidden via CSS (sr-only pattern, NOT DOM-removed), icons show, group-head title=label & aria-label=label. Clicking a collapsed group head calls onToggleCollapsed() (expands whole sidebar) and opens that group (no hover flyout). Collapse toggle button (.menu-collapse) in footer with aria-expanded(=!collapsed), aria-controls='app-menu', localized aria-label/title nav.collapse/nav.expand. NOTE: no topbar-mirrored toggle was added (design says 'optionally'/'mirrored for discoverability'; footer toggle satisfies the ACs and keeps the change minimal) — add one in the topbar later if desired. styles.css: collapsed grid-column 252px->64px with transition on grid-template-columns; .menu-icon hidden by default, shown when collapsed; .menu-label sr-only when collapsed; all LOGICAL props (padding-inline, inline-size, inset-inline-start) so check:css passes. Mobile breakpoint (<=820px) explicitly RESETS collapse (drawer governs): labels restored, icons hidden, .menu-collapse hidden — do not regress this if you touch the media query. i18n: added nav.editProfile, nav.newPass, nav.collapse, nav.expand (plain strings, no placeholders) to all 7 catalogs (en, es-MX, es-ES, pt-BR, fr, de, ar); en-XA.json untouched (build regenerates it). Tests: menu.test.ts gained a resident-child-links assertion; new test/shell-collapse.test.tsx (5 tests) covers toggle flips data-collapsed + aria-expanded, localStorage persistence (stubs a Map-backed localStorage because jsdom here has no working localStorage; also mocks ../src/offline.js because SyncBadge uses indexedDB), restore-from-storage, collapsed a11y names/tooltips, and click-collapsed-group-expands-and-opens. No API/migration/notify changes (pure web/nav feature). Full gate green: core build, typecheck, pnpm test (web 107+1skip, api 108, core), check:css.
